```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ",")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Number of films:", nrow(movies)),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```




```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_gap, y = reorder(genre, mean_gap))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Critic vs. Audience Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Average Tomatometer minus Audience Score (genres with at least 100 films)",
    x = "Average Gap",
    y = "Genre"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% c(
    "Spider-Man",
    "Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man 3",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
    "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
    "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
  )) |>
  mutate(
    actor = case_when(
      title %in% c("Spider-Man", "Spider-Man 2", "Spider-Man 3") ~ "Tobey Maguire",
      str_detect(title, "The Amazing") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
      str_detect(title, ":") ~ "Tom Holland"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  mutate(film = factor(title, levels = title)) |>
  select(film, tomatoMeter, audienceScore) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = film, y = score, color = score_type, group = score_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("tomatoMeter" = "red", "audienceScore" = "blue"),
    labels = c("tomatoMeter" = "Critics", "audienceScore" = "Audience")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Spider-Man: Critics and Audiences Don't Always Agree",
    subtitle = "Tomatometer vs. Audience Score across eight Spider-Man films",
    x = "Movie",
    y = "Score",
    color = "Rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
